positions.as_written: Identify the structure to be freed and the plane around it before starting.
Place the needle tip in the plane rather than in the structure, which is the critical distinction.
Avoid injecting into the nerve itself, which is the hazard the imaging exists to prevent.
The nerve is the usual target because adhesion around a nerve produces symptoms that freeing it may relieve, and the nerve is also the structure that must not be injected.
